name: share-strip
title: Share Strip
description: One hard-bordered 100% strip with in-segment labels for larger parts and a complete value-and-percent legend.

meta.question: What makes up the whole, in one strip?
meta.whenToUse: Flat part-to-whole composition of a handful of categories where the single-strip proportion is the message.
meta.antiUse: Hierarchies or many small categories — use treemap; comparing composition across subjects — use verdict-stack.
